create_audio_vae_model: create an LTX2 audio VAE model from a configuration for encoding and decoding audio spectrograms
encode_audio_spectrogram: encode audio spectrogram tensors into latent representations using the LTX2AudioEncoder
decode_audio_latents: decode audio latent tensors back into spectrogram outputs using the LTX2AudioDecoder
build_causal_convolution: build a causal 2D convolution layer with asymmetric padding along the specified causality axis
run_vae_forward_pass: run a full VAE forward pass encoding and decoding audio samples with optional posterior sampling
